name: Cyprian Wetende
description: Cyprian Wetende, Technical Lead at Datecho Analytics. Power BI dashboards, data analysis, SQL, Python, Excel and Tableau, with integrations and reporting automation.
intro: I turn business data into clear reports and practical insights. My work spans Power BI dashboards, data analysis with Python, pandas and SQL, and reporting in Excel and Tableau. At Datecho, I combine analytics with the integrations and automation that keep business information useful.

projects.title: Power BI dashboards & reporting
projects.subtitle: Business performance, clearly presented
projects.summary: Interactive Power BI reports that bring business metrics, trends and comparisons into one clear view.
projects.focus: Business intelligence, KPI reporting and data visualisation
projects.challenge: Business information often sits across spreadsheets and operational systems. Decision-makers need consistent measures and clear reports that answer the questions behind day-to-day performance.
scope: Define the business questions, reporting audience and key performance indicators.
Prepare and connect source data, with clear relationships and consistent metric definitions.
Build interactive Power BI report pages with filters, comparisons and drill-down views.
Validate report figures against the source data and document how the report should be used.
projects.delivery: Start with the decisions the report needs to support, then prepare the data, develop the report and review the figures with the team. The scope is agreed around the organisation’s actual data and reporting needs.
projects.relevance: Power BI reporting is part of Datecho’s analytics and visualisation services. I bring data preparation, modelling and technical integration together with the reporting layer.

projects.title: Data analysis & preparation
projects.subtitle: From raw records to useful findings
projects.summary: Prepare, explore and analyse business data using Python, pandas, SQL and Excel, then communicate the findings through clear reports and visuals.
projects.focus: Data cleaning, exploratory analysis and reporting
projects.challenge: Before a dataset can support a decision, its structure and quality need to be understood. Missing values, duplicate records, inconsistent formats and unclear definitions can hide the patterns people need to see.
scope: Review data sources, field definitions, completeness and consistency.
Clean and transform records with Python, pandas, SQL and Excel.
Explore trends, category breakdowns and period comparisons relevant to the business question.
Present findings through summaries, charts and reporting views, including Tableau or Excel where appropriate.
Document preparation steps so the analysis can be checked and repeated.
projects.delivery: Agree the question, inspect and prepare the data, then examine the patterns and explain the findings. Repeatable preparation steps and clear definitions make the analysis easier to maintain as new data arrives.
projects.relevance: This offering aligns with Datecho’s data analytics services: preparing dependable data, interpreting operational information and making the findings useful to business teams.

projects.title: Datecho Analytics
projects.subtitle: A data-backed company platform
projects.summary: A Django and MySQL platform connecting company content, enquiries and media to the public website.
projects.focus: Structured content, enquiry records and reliable delivery
projects.image_alt: Datecho Analytics homepage with its analytics headline and chart image
projects.challenge: Company pages depend on more than their layout. Content, staff profiles, uploaded images and enquiries need a consistent home in the application, with a dependable path from the database to the website.
scope: Django models and CMS-backed company content, including services, team profiles and media.
Enquiry persistence before notification email, so an email failure does not discard the enquiry.
Explicit production database configuration, repeatable content setup and media-delivery checks.
Public interfaces built with React and Inertia, with permission-aware client proof and consent-gated analytics.
projects.delivery: The production rollout was checked against the actual MySQL database and public pages. Contact details, staff profiles and responsive homepage images were verified after deployment.
projects.relevance: This is the application layer around an analytics business: organising records, validating updates and making information available through consistent interfaces. That same discipline supports trustworthy reporting workflows.

projects.title: KyroChat
projects.subtitle: Knowledge retrieval and support automation
projects.summary: An AI support and operations platform built around knowledge retrieval, a shared assistant core, guardrails and channel integrations.
projects.challenge: Useful support automation depends on access to relevant knowledge and clear system boundaries. A shared core needs to work with the interfaces and channels through which people use it.
scope: Custom knowledge retrieval using vector-based search.
A shared assistant core with guardrails and provider integrations.
Website and messaging-channel adapters for support and operations workflows.
projects.delivery: A shared assistant core brings knowledge retrieval and guardrails into the application. Channel adapters connect that core to website and messaging interfaces.
projects.relevance: Many data workflows involve finding and using organisational knowledge. Retrieval and integration experience is useful when connecting information sources to practical operational tools.

projects.title: DigiKaTech
projects.subtitle: Enrolment, checkout and learner journeys
projects.summary: A technical education platform connecting public learning pathways, payment checkout and learner progression through one application experience.
projects.focus: Provider integrations and connected application journeys
projects.challenge: Learning pathways, checkout and student progression are separate parts of one experience. Connecting them requires clear application flows and deliberate integration with external providers.
scope: Public education pathways and student-facing application journeys.
Django, Inertia and React interfaces supporting learning progression.
projects.delivery: Learning pathways, payment checkout and student progression are connected through a Django and Inertia application, with React providing the student-facing interface.
projects.relevance: Integration work is relevant when business information has to move between tools. It provides experience with application boundaries, provider APIs and the operational journeys that produce data.
